title: Review: Energy stores and systems; Changes in energy

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Heating
items.clue: A transfer of energy caused by a difference in temperature.

items.label: Gravitational potential energy (Ep)
items.clue: What an object gains when it is lifted higher above the ground.

items.label: Spring constant (k)
items.clue: The force needed to stretch it by one metre; a measure of stiffness.

items.label: Limit of proportionality
items.clue: The point beyond which stretch no longer rises in step with the force applied.

questions.stem: 0.50 kg of water is heated from 20 °C to 90 °C. The specific heat capacity of water is 4200 J/kg °C. Using ΔE = m c Δθ, what is the change in thermal energy?
In the equation E_e = 1/2 k e^2, the spring constant k is measured in which unit?

options.text: newtons times metres, N m
newtons per kilogram, N/kg
newtons per centimetre, N/cm
newtons per metre, N/m

questions.explanation: The spring constant is the force needed for each metre of extension, so it is measured in N/m.

questions.stem: A heater is switched on under a beaker of water. What does heating the water do?

options.text: It raises its temperature but transfers no energy.
It fills the kinetic store of the beaker.
It transfers energy to the water's thermal store.
It uses up energy inside the water each second.

questions.explanation: Heating is a transfer route, and the store it fills is the thermal store of the water.

questions.stem: A spring of unstretched length 0.20 m is stretched to a length of 0.26 m. Which length is the extension e used in E_e = 1/2 k e^2?

options.text: the whole stretched length, in metres
the increase in length, in metres
the length before stretching, in metres
the extra length, in centimetres

questions.explanation: The extension is 0.26 - 0.20 = 0.06 m, and the equation needs it in metres.

questions.stem: A constant force of 40 N pushes a crate 2.5 m across a floor, in the direction of the force. Using W = F s, how much work is done?
A spring is stretched so far that its limit of proportionality has been exceeded. What does this mean for E_e = 1/2 k e^2?

options.text: the equation still works if e is measured again
the spring constant doubles from that point on
the equation can no longer be used to find the energy
the stored energy still rises with e squared

questions.explanation: The specification states the equation assuming the limit of proportionality has not been exceeded, so beyond that limit it does not apply.

questions.stem: A constant resultant force does work on an object moving horizontally along the line of the force. What does this work do?

options.text: It fills the kinetic store of the object.
It is stored as force inside the moving object.
It uses up the energy the object already has.
It makes the object rise as its kinetic store fills.

questions.explanation: Work done by a resultant force along the motion transfers energy to the kinetic store.

questions.stem: Which two quantities must be known to calculate the elastic potential energy stored in a stretched spring?

options.text: the spring constant and the extension
the spring constant and the force used
the mass of the spring and its extension
the spring constant and the length

questions.explanation: E_e = 1/2 k e^2 needs only the spring constant k, in N/m, and the extension e, in m.

questions.stem: A 2000 W kettle is switched on for 90 s. Using P = E / t, how much energy is transferred by the current?
questions.explanation: P = E / t rearranges to E = P t, so E = 2000 × 90 = 180 000 J.

questions.stem: A book of mass 800 g is lifted through a height of 1.5 m. The gravitational field strength is 10 N/kg. How much gravitational potential energy does the book gain?

options.text: 6 J

questions.stem: A current flows through the heating element of a hairdryer. Which statement is correct?

options.text: The element holds a store of electrical energy inside itself.
The current is used up as it passes through the element.
The current does work, filling the element's thermal store.
The chemical store of the metal wire empties into it.

questions.explanation: Work done when a current flows is the transfer route; the thermal store fills.

questions.stem: A box is pushed 5.0 m up a ramp and ends up 2.0 m above the ground. Which value is used as h in E_p = m g h?

options.text: 5.0 m, the distance moved along the ramp surface
3.0 m, the difference in the two distances
2.0 m, the vertical height risen above the ground
7.0 m, the two distances added together

questions.explanation: h is the vertical height gained, and the path taken up the ramp does not change it.
